CustomField.description: Checks whether shift start/end timings and drive start/end timings are different
CustomField.formula: AND(sked_Drive_Date__c >= TODAY(), NOT(ISPICKVAL(sked_Status__c , 'Cancel')), OR ((sked_Start_Time__c != Min_Shift_Draw_Start__c) , ( sked_End_Time__c != Max_Shift_Draw_End__c )))
CustomField.label: is Shift Start or End Different
